description: Distinguish the major generative-AI model families and implement tokenization and PyTorch data pipelines, including Specialization Introduction Generative AI and LLMs: Architecture and Data Preparation, Tokenization techniques with NLTK, spaCy, Hugging Face, PyTorch data loaders and pipelines for generative AI.

Build NLP systems using foundational language-modelling techniques, including Gen AI Foundational Models for NLP & Language Understanding, Word embeddings: Word2Vec, GloVe, Document classification, Encoder-decoder RNNs, Introduction to attention mechanisms.

Apply transformer LLMs to generation, classification, translation, and understanding tasks, including Generative AI Language Modeling with Transformers, Transformer architecture in depth, Applying transformers to translation, classification, and text generation.

Adapt LLMs for domain tasks using PEFT, instruction tuning, and alignment, including Generative AI Engineering and Fine-Tuning Transformers, Hugging Face fine-tuning pipelines, Parameter-efficient fine-tuning: LoRA, QLoRA, adapters, Quantization for fine-tuning on consumer GPUs, Generative AI Advance Fine-Tuning for LLMs, Instruction tuning.

Design, build, and deploy production LLM applications using RAG, vector stores, and agent patterns, including Fundamentals of AI Agents Using RAG and LangChain, LangChain components, chains, agents, Embeddings, vector stores, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
